$comment: Machine-readable mirror of pinned artifacts. Keep checksums and revisions aligned with scripts/fetch-models.sh. Candidate evaluation artifacts remain gitignored and are not bundled in release APKs. The sherpa-onnx Parakeet TDT-CTC 110M candidate lane was retired with the app-managed Parakeet engine (M27); the LiteRT ASR benchmark lane uses its own litert-asr inputs (scripts/stage-litert-asr-inputs.sh). The Kokoro TTS graph is the one model that IS built into the app: its file lands under the models/kokoro-assets asset source directory and app/build.gradle.kts registers that directory as an asset source, so it is packaged as assets/kokoro/af_heart/model_int8.onnx (docs/decisions.md §2.4).
